title: STL Forge
description: Convert a single image into a 3D-printable STL file via Hunyuan3D 2.1 (shape-only) and a trimesh cleanup pipeline (manifold check, hole fill, decimation, recentre). Returns a watertight binary STL plus a printability report. Billed per request on RunPod Serverless.

input.name: S3-compatible endpoint URL
input.description: Optional. Required for outputs above the inline response limit (for example https://s3.filebase.com or your R2/B2 endpoint).

input.name: Storage access key ID
input.description: Optional S3-compatible access key. Configure all four storage fields together.

input.name: Storage secret access key
input.description: Optional S3-compatible secret key. Treat this value as a credential.

input.name: Storage bucket name
input.description: Optional bucket name used for large STL outputs.
